"""Task-local helper: add a cover page (title 'Annual Financial Report', current date)
to report.pdf, then validate the result. Operates only on report.pdf in the workspace."""
import datetime
import os
import sys
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
REPORT = "report.pdf"


def build_cover_pdf(path):
    """Create a US Letter cover page matching report.pdf's 612x792 media box."""
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter  # 612 x 792

    # Date to display on the cover (operator runtime current date)
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Decorative line above the title area
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.15)
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(72, height - 220, width - 72, height - 220)

    # Title, vertically balanced toward the center of the page
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.05, 0.05, 0.1)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 32)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 40, TITLE)

    # Current date beneath the title
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.25, 0.25, 0.3)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 10, date_str)

    # Second decorative line below the date
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.15)
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(72, height / 2.0 - 50, width - 72, height / 2.0 - 50)

    c.save()
    return date_str


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in", os.getcwd())
        return 1

    reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    original_count = len(reader.pages)
    print("ORIGINAL_PAGES:", original_count)

    # Build cover page in a temp file, then merge: cover + original report pages.
    fd, cover_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf", prefix="cover_")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        date_str = build_cover_pdf(cover_path)
        print("DATE_USED:", date_str)

        cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
        cover_page = cover_reader.pages[0]

        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(cover_page)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

        # Atomic replace of report.pdf with cover-prefixed version
        fd2, merged_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf", prefix="merged_")
        os.close(fd2)
        try:
            with open(merged_path, "wb") as fh:
                writer.write(fh)
            os.replace(merged_path, REPORT)
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(merged_path):
                os.remove(merged_path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(cover_path):
            os.remove(cover_path)

    # ---- Validation ----
    check = PdfReader(REPORT)
    final_count = len(check.pages)
    first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print("FINAL_PAGES:", final_count)
    print("FIRST_PAGE_HAS_TITLE:", TITLE in first_text)
    print("FIRST_PAGE_TEXT:", repr(first_text[:200]))

    ok = final_count == original_count + 1 and TITLE in first_text and date_str in first_text
    print("VALIDATION_OK:", ok)
    return 0 if ok else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
